description:
If anything stays the same in the age of AI, I believe it is purpose.
I'm Jihye Moon, a developer growing into someone who can identify what really matters in a given situation and find the optimal answer.

values.title: I start with the essence
values.description: Before building a feature, I define what problem the service is trying to solve. When the purpose is clear, it becomes easy to cut what isn't needed.

values.title: I dig until I find the optimum
values.description: I don't stop at "it works." I check why it works and whether a better structure exists. Solving the concurrency problem in first-come-first-served matching at the database level is one example.

values.title: I care about how a team works together
values.description: As backend lead on team projects, I learned that settling API specs and working agreements up front largely determines the quality of the result.
